name: 16f batched adapters
title: Two LoRA adapters in one forward pass
subtitle: Base W has rows (2, 1) and (0, 1). Legal adapter A = (1, 1), B = (1, 0). Medical adapter A = (1, -1), B = (0, 2)

steps.caption: Three tokens share one batch. Tokens 1 and 3 belong to requests that use the legal adapter, token 2 to a request that uses the medical adapter.
The frozen base runs once for the whole batch: one matrix multiply gives Wx = (4, 2), (6, 0) and (1, 1).
Each token gathers the A of its own adapter. The legal A = (1, 1) gives 3 and 1 for tokens 1 and 3, and the medical A = (1, -1) gives 3 for token 2.
Each token multiplies that number by its own adapter B, giving (3, 0), (0, 6) and (1, 0).
Adding the base and adapter paths gives (7, 2), (6, 6) and (2, 1). Merging the legal adapter into W would give the same (7, 2) for token 1 but would break token 2.
At real scale a decode step for 32 requests reads the 13.48 GB base once, and 8 distinct rank 16 adapters add 0.64 GB, 4.7% more bytes.
